description: With a little more than a month to go before Election Day, Congressman Juan Ciscomani's campaign released a new ad today called “ Directly From Me. ” Instead of leaving voters to sort through the noise of a crowded campaign season, Ciscomani lays out the facts about his record.
title: NEW AD: JUAN CISCOMANI’S RECORD IN HIS OWN WORDS — Juan Ciscomani for Congress
